design_philosophy: Swiss High-Contrast Minimalism. Achromatic foundation (warm off-white and pure white) with a single vibrant accent color used strictly for function. High density grid for dashboard structure, combined with featherlight elevation (1px borders, no shadows).

visual_enhancers.elevation: Featherlight: Use 1px solid borders (border-neutral-200) and completely avoid drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Technical & Crisp: Use rounded-sm (4px) universally for all cards, buttons, and inputs.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a highly transparent, subtle SVG noise overlay across the main body background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must shift background color distinctly (e.g., hover:bg-neutral-100).

layouts.page_structure: Single open dashboard view with a top navigation bar (Solid white, 1px bottom border, sticky top-0, z-50). Main content max-w-7xl with p-6 or p-8.
layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (High Density). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-6.

sections.name: Overview Stats
sections.description: 3 distinct metric cards (Apps Running, Total Deployments, Uptime).

sections.name: Projects List
sections.description: List of running apps with status badges, uptime, and start/stop/restart icon buttons.

sections.name: Deployment & Logs
sections.description: Upload zone (drag & drop) paired with a live deploy logs viewer (dark terminal look).

sections.name: Domain Management
sections.description: Input for custom domain and list of mapped domains with DNS status.

components.Buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary uses accent color (bg-[#FF4400] text-white). Secondary uses white background with 1px border.
components.Cards: Pure white background, 1px border (border-neutral-200), rounded-sm, p-6. NO SHADOWS.
components.Logs_Viewer: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-[#F5F5F5] rounded-sm p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-y-auto h-[250px]. Use color spans for logs.
components.Upload_Zone: Dashed border, bg-neutral-50, min-h-[150px] flex items-center justify-center. Transition hover state.
components.Charts: Recharts. Remove grid lines or make them extremely faint. Use monochromatic lines.
components.Badges: Pill-shaped or rounded-sm text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5. Status driven (e.g., bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover transitions on buttons and list items.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for grid items using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets 4.5:1 ratio. focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text in index.css.
Override default Shadcn styles: remove all drop-shadows on cards and buttons, use strictly 1px borders and rounded-sm.
Do not implement complex routing. All components (Stats, Projects, Deployments, Logs, Resources, Domains) should be visible on a single scrollable dashboard page.
Build the log viewer as a dark '#0A0A0A' terminal block to contrast the light minimal layout.
Use Recharts for Resource Monitoring charts. Keep them clean and minimalist.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and major containers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' look: use crisp lines, generous padding (p-6/p-8), and intentional whitespace.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do NOT use center-aligned text generically. Left-align text for better readability.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays or navbars.
